messages:
maya: Quick async check — I'm about to land a small change to clarify chat/completions behavior for streaming deltas + toolcall args. TL;DR: make 'arguments' always a stringified JSON in toolcall deltas (not an object) so streaming chunks are stable. Thoughts?

jordan: Prefer stringified too. keeps delta tokens simple and avoids mid-chunk parse errors. can we add lint that warns when tool args are non-string at API surface? :+1:

oli: One nit: if we stringify, we should pick a canonical spacing (no pretty) and always escape newlines. otherwise clients might differ. also clarify whether clients should treat missing 'arguments' as empty string or absent.

maya: Good call. Proposal: canonical minified JSON (JSON.stringify) and spec says missing -> treat as "" for backward compat. I'll add exact wording.

sara: Heads-up: I'll need this decision before end of day for the convo-schema PR (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/428). Ping me when you push the spec text and I can update tests.

jordan: Also a runtime concern — streaming runtime emits partial tokens. If 'arguments' is string, we still need to signal finalization. Proposal: include delta.event="toolcall.final" when the toolcall args are complete. Otherwise clients can't know when to parse.

maya: Agreed. I'll add delta.event values: "toolcall.start", "toolcall.fragment", "toolcall.final". Implementation note: fragments may arrive in multiple chunk messages.

oli: Confirming fallback behavior: if a non-streaming response (batch) returns arguments as object (old style), runtime should accept and treat it as equivalent to the stringified form. We shouldn't break existing clients.

maya: Yes — runtime accepts both. Spec will say server MAY return object for non-streaming legacy responses but SHOULD return string for streaming. We'll add compatibility tests.

jordan: Quick example we can put in the doc for clarity:
```
// streaming chunk example (JSONL over SSE)
data: {"delta": {"event": "toolcall.fragment", "arguments": "{\"query\":\"count\":10}"}}
data: {"delta": {"event": "toolcall.fragment", "arguments": "...rest..."}}
data: {"delta": {"event": "toolcall.final"}}
```

sara: tiny formatting nit: in the example above the inner string is already JSON — show minified canonical, e.g. `{"query":"count","n":10}` not spaced. I'll update the PR once spec text is up.

maya: One more compatibility edge: message role nullability. Current clients sometimes send messages with role omitted vs role:null. Recommendation: treat omitted == "user" fallback for legacy callers, but require explicit role in new SDKs. I'll add migration notes + deprecation timeline.

oli: Sounds reasonable. Put the migration steps and a deprecation date (e.g., 90 days) in the doc. Ops wants 30 day heads-up before enforcement.

maya: Noted. I'll set soft deprecation at 90 days, enforcement after ops confirmation.

jordan: CI checklist for the PR: 1) schema lint rule, 2) runtime acceptance tests for both forms, 3) example client parsing updated. Can you assign reviewers?

maya: Assigning @sara and @oli now. Also pinging @deploy-bot to schedule a small canary rollout of the runtime change after merge.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: runtime.canary v0.89.2 -> 3 nodes in staging at 2023-11-02T18:00Z. Reply with :rocket: to confirm.

sara: :rocket: I'll follow up on tests.

oli: LGTM, leaving a small inline comment on canonicalization details in the PR.

maya: Thanks all — I'll push spec PR in ~30m and post link here. If anyone needs an RFC meeting, say now, otherwise async is fine.
